title: ChangeReport
description: What the change-executor actually did to the cluster for one approved remediation. Distinct from Finding on purpose: a finding says what is wrong, a change report says what changed. Reusing one contract for both is how 'proposed' and 'applied' end up indistinguishable in an incident log.

applied.description: True only if a mutating call completed successfully. False when the operator refused it, when the write gate was in dry_run, or when the call failed — say which in outcome.

action.description: The change, as executed: the tool called and what it did, e.g. 'patch_k8s_resource: set spec.template.spec.containers[0].resources.limits.memory=1Gi'.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of the changed object. Empty for cluster-scoped changes.

kind.description: Kubernetes kind of the changed object, capitalized and singular: Pod, Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Node, Job, CronJob, Service, ConfigMap, Secret.

resource_name.description: Name of the changed object, exactly as it appears in the cluster.

outcome.description: What happened after the change, or why it did not happen: the observed state, the operator's refusal, or the error returned.

rollback.description: How to undo this change, concretely — the inverse patch, the previous revision number. Empty only when nothing was applied.
